name: Nike Factory Store
description: Nike Factory Outlet Store near Mulund West, Mumbai offers an amazing selection of performance and athleisure apparel and footwear. It's got sportswear and accessories at remarkable prices which makes it the go to store for athletes. As the world's leading sportswear brand, Nike's mission is to bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world.

owner_posts.post_text: Step in to the techy, unconventional look of the Nike Zoom Air Fire. Nodding to the history of performance running, these sneakers create a fresh look with rich textures and layers. Exaggerated design lines and boldly framed Zoom Air cushioning combine with a thick foam midsole, adding comfort to go along with your defiant style.

Whether you're starting your running journey or an expert eager to switch up your pace, the Downshifter 13 is down for the ride. With breathable mesh and an updated internal fit band, it helps you find that extra gear or take that first stride towards chasing down your goals.

Up for a workout or down to chill, this Nike One Classic top is ready for whatever you are. Lightweight, silky-smooth fabric dries quickly and works for wherever your day takes you. A timeless, easy-fitting style and sweat-wicking tech help you feel confident, comfortable and dry from your morning stroll to your evening wind-down- and at all the stops in between.

Revolution 7 with the sort of soft cushioning and support that might change your running world. Stylish as ever, comfortable when the rubber meets the road, it's an evolution of a fan favourite that offers a soft, smooth ride.

The Nike Air Max Dawn is a retro-inspired, sporty sneaker featuring a lightweight, vintage running design with modernized Air cushioning. It combines a sleek neutral aesthetic with subtle, vibrant accents, making it an excellent everyday lifestyle shoe.
Fast-forward your footsteps in the cutting-edge Nike Interact Run. It’s set up with all the running goodness you need: a lightweight Flyknit upper, soft foam midsole and comfort where it counts

Take your gear to go with the Nike Heritage Backpack. Its spacious main compartment features a sleeve that holds up to a 15" laptop, so your computer is never out of reach. 2 zipped accessories pockets help keep your gear organized and easy to grab. This product is made from at least 65% recycled polyester fibres.
Wrap yourself in comfortable organic cotton. Made with slightly dropped shoulders, the loose fit brings a relaxed, casual feel.

Move with ease in these lightweight, sweat-wicking trousers that provide the perfect balance of room and stretch. Tapered legs allow you to run without distraction, while hand pockets let you stash your essentials. Plus, mesh panels behind the knees give you airflow when your miles heat up.
Stay comfortable on the path in this graphic running tee. Its smooth cotton-blend fabric is enhanced with Nike Dri-FIT tech, which moves sweat away from your skin for quicker evaporation.

featured_reviews.name: Note & Navigate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place for shoe shopping and found it to be a good factory outlet offering plenty of deals, with “Buy 2 Get 2” being the most common offer.
The collection is mixed and decent, not extraordinary, but you can still find some good picks.

Parking is available in the mall at a flat charge of ₹60, but it’s better to carry cash as the network inside is not very reliable for online payments.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Bhujade
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited the Nike Outlet in Mulund recently and had a fantastic time. The store is well-stocked with a great range of footwear, apparel, and accessories. A special shoutout to Pushkar, who went above and beyond to help me find the perfect pair - the Nike Air Max 270. He was patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely understood what I was looking for. Highly recommend this store, and ask for Pushkar if you want a smooth, guided shopping experience!
